text: Gefitinib is an ATP-competitive epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) tyrosine kinase inhibitor that selectively binds to the intracellular catalytic domain of EGFR, preventing its autophosphorylation and downstream signal transduction (such as the RAS/RAF/MEK/ERK and PI3K/AKT pathways). In non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), this interaction is particularly potent in tumors harboring activating *EGFR* kinase domain mutations (e.g., exon 19 deletions or the L858R point mutation), which increase the receptor's affinity for gefitinib compared to wild-type EGFR. By blocking these hyperactive survival and proliferation signals, gefitinib effectively inhibits tumor growth and induces apoptosis in EGFR-mutant NSCLC cells.
